author: Gene Holcombe
text: Those are 2 totally different issues.  One has to do with you and keeping it on your arm. Abbott has nothing to do with that. Use skintac or a bandaid to keep it attached   Sensors don’t just fall off.  You might want to find out why they fall off of you.  My sensors have to be yanked off.

author: Linda Goins Fox
text: I use SkinTac under mine. If it looks like the edges are losning up a bit put some more skin tac around the edges.
